calculation.description: Parkinson vol-scaled 1d reversal on the 15-name cross-asset panel; positive value predicts higher next-day cross-sectional return (daily rank IC). Long-only portfolio uses high values as long bias.

validation.regime_notes: Validated 2021-2026 across 2022 bear, 2023-24 recovery, 2025-26 crypto/commodity regimes. Effective library empty at validation time; pairwise rho controlled within this batch (<0.5). Short-horizon mean reversion dominates this cross-asset panel.

provenance.computed_from: real daily OHLC data (no fabricated metrics)
